---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible implementation or documentation defect
---

## Expected and observed behavior

## Reproduction

Provide minimal synthetic input, component version and deployment phase.

## Evidence

Include sanitized status and error types. Never include credentials, customer data or complete private traces. Use the security policy for sensitive vulnerabilities.

## Environment and scope

Core / contract test / native deployment / documentation. Include OS, Python and relevant product versions.
